title: xanthoxalis fontana
intro: Xanthoxalis fontana, commonly known as woodland sorrel or sheep's sorrel, is a perennial herb that belongs to the family Oxalidaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating digestive issues, kidney stones, and as an anti-inflammatory agent due to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Xanthoxalis fontana include oxalic acid, malic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, respiratory problems, and as a diuretic to aid in urinary tract issues.
